name: waitfeed-dev
description: Dev harness for the WaitFeed plugin — typecheck and tests. The published npm package lives in .opencode/plugins/waitfeed.

scripts.build:agy: esbuild .opencode/plugins/waitfeed/agy/src/scheduler.ts .opencode/plugins/waitfeed/agy/src/statusline.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outdir=.opencode/plugins/waitfeed/agy/dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=warning
